plugins.name: lemlist
plugins.description: 39-skill GTM / outbound library from lemlist (l3mpire/claude-skills) — ICP, sourcing, cold email & LinkedIn copywriting, campaign design, benchmarking, CRM hygiene, n8n automation. Minus the Claap-specific skill. Plus copy-lemlist (Romain): fills a whole Lemlist multichannel campaign by API (A/B emails, LinkedIn, tasks), leads-first, benchmark-backed, French SMB founders.

plugins.name: tools
plugins.description: General-purpose technical skills. youtube-transcript: read any YouTube video's transcript as plain text (yt subtitles), no API key or cookie. apify-fetch: reliable web fetching via Apify (residential IPs, no 403) — YouTube transcripts + full-site crawl to clean markdown; replaces Supadata; needs APIFY_TOKEN. scrapling: web scraping via the Scrapling lib (Fetcher decision tree, Cloudflare bypass, login sessions, HTML parsing); needs an open network (local/VPS).

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Productivity skills. analyse-pertinence (fetch a URL's content — YouTube video or website — via Apify, then judge if it's relevant for Romain and how to reuse it; needs APIFY_TOKEN), grill-me (stress-test a plan via relentless interview), handoff (compact a conversation into a handoff doc), write-a-skill (author new skills properly), write-like-me (rewrite in the user's own voice, no AI tells), malt-response (winning Malt proposal playbook), malt-workflow (end-to-end Malt offer handling: pulls the offer from Gmail, judges fit, drafts the reply + a direct reinforcement email, or builds a profile-ranking dossier when off-target), brainstorm (structured brainstorm: grill-me interrogation + superpowers design flow, idea to validated design/action plan), i-have-adhd (output shaped for an ADHD reader: next action first, numbered steps, state restated every turn; manual /i-have-adhd, from ayghri/i-have-adhd, MIT).

plugins.name: gtm-strategy
plugins.description: Ciblage GTM en français, chiffré et défendable. tam : parcours complet (icp-builder → market-sizing → abm) en un seul livrable. icp-builder : ICP 4 dimensions + ICP négatif + grille de score sur 100, tiré des deals gagnés du CRM. market-sizing : TAM/SAM/SOM bottom-up d'abord, top-down en contrôle, SOM dérivé de la capacité commerciale, hypothèses avec confiance et sensibilité. abm : tiers 1/2/3 calés sur la capacité, score d'engagement par compte, règles de passage. Aucun chiffre inventé, lecture seule sur le CRM.

plugins.name: meta-ads
plugins.description: Skills Meta Ads : structure de campagne, audiences, idées et textes de pub, notation des vidéos, suivi des conversions, audit du compte. Copie des 8 skills Meta du plugin public Bulldozer Collective (bulldozer-collective/bulldozer-claude-marketplace, version 1.8.3 du 30/10/2026).
